incoming.title: Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair
incoming.description: NOVEMBER 21, 2026  Makers Market’s™ Local Artist Street Fair is returning to Santana Row! We’ve rounded up the best local Artists, Crafters, Designers, and Makers for a truly unforgettable shopping experience for every second Saturday of every month from 11am-6pm!60+ Local MakersHandmade jewelry, permanent jewelry, ceramics, woodwork, apparel, leather goods, glass art, candles, local honey, apothecary, art, crochet, pet treats/products, handbags, plants, and moreGreat food + drinks in the surrounding eateries. THIS IS A SIP & STROLL EVENT!Bring your kids + fur babiesEnjoy live music by local artistsFREE to attend!Shop in store! Stroll into our brick-and-mortar shop (adjacent to the market area) for more American-made jewelry, apparel, body products, home goods and more from 100+ Makers.

published.title: Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair
published.description: November 21, 2026. Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair is returning to Santana Row! We've rounded up the best local artists, crafters, designers, and makers for a truly unforgettable shopping experience on the second Saturday of every month from 11 AM-6 PM! 60+ local makers offer handmade jewelry, permanent jewelry, ceramics, woodwork, apparel, leather goods, glass art, candles, local honey, apothecary, art, crochet, pet treats/products, handbags, plants, and more. Great food + drinks in the surrounding eateries. This is a sip-and-stroll event! Bring your kids + fur babies. Enjoy live music by local artists. Free to attend! Shop in store! Stroll into our brick-and-mortar shop (adjacent to the market area) for more American-made jewelry, apparel, body products, home goods and more from 100+ makers.
